cards.name: A New Hope
cards.effect: Enemy units do not spawn on the next enemy turn.

cards.name: Card Refresh
cards.effect: Replace all cards. Neutralized cards cannot be replaced.

cards.name: Defection
cards.effect: Can be used when there are 2 enemies on the coordinates. When used on one enemy, the enemy at the same coordinates engages each other. Depending on the situation, it can be useful.

cards.name: Flash Grenade
cards.effect: All enemies within 1-3 range are incapacitated once.

cards.name: Reinforcements
cards.effect: Draw all new unit cards.

cards.name: Scan Pulse
cards.effect: Draw and take one of 3 Star Cards (one face down, 2 face up).

cards.name: Suppressive Fire
cards.effect: Pushes an enemy unit back one coordinate.

cards.name: A-Wing Shield
cards.effect: Adds one shield when equipped on A-wing.

cards.name: Concussion Warheads
cards.effect: Adds 3 firepower when equipped on an A-wing.

cards.name: Evasive Maneuvers
cards.effect: Adds 2 evasion when equipped on an air unit.

cards.name: Power Distribution
cards.effect: Select and apply one of the following items when mounting on a gas unit. - Firepower +2 - Shield +3 - Ion Weapon Perc

cards.name: Proton Torpedoes
cards.effect: When equipped on the X-wing, it grants heavy weapon perc.

cards.name: Sensor Jammer
cards.effect: Adds 2 evasion when equipped on a snowspeeder.

cards.name: T-47 Speed Boost
cards.effect: When equipped on a snowspeeder, it grants a preemptive strike perk.

cards.name: Towing Cable
cards.effect: Destroys an AT-AT in one hit when equipped on a snowspeeder. Required when AT-AT comes out.

cards.name: X-Wing Shield
cards.effect: When equipped on the X-wing, adds one protective layer.

cards.name: Adrenaline Steam
cards.effect: When equipped to infantry units, grants rage perk and adds 1 firepower.

cards.name: Bacta Bomb
cards.effect: When equipped to an infantry unit, grants Squad Leader Perk and all friendly units recover 1 HP per turn when engaged.

cards.name: Grenade Bombardment
cards.effect: When equipped to an infantry unit, it grants the Heavy Weapons perk and adds 3 Attack.

cards.name: Bowcaster
cards.effect: Adds 2 attack and 3 firepower when worn on infantry units.

cards.name: Cooling Battery
cards.effect: When equipped to an infantry unit, grants Behemoth Perk and adds 1 Attack.

cards.name: Cycler Rifle
cards.effect: When equipped to an infantry unit, grants Heavy Weapon Perk and +2 Firepower.

cards.name: Hindrance
cards.effect: When equipped on an infantry unit, enemies cannot attack that unit.

cards.name: Explosive Bullet
cards.effect: When equipped to an infantry unit, it gives first strike perk and adds 2 firepower.

cards.name: Concentrated Fire
cards.effect: Adds 3 ATK when worn on infantry units.

cards.name: Guided Missile
cards.effect: Gives an infantry unit Overload Perk when equipped and adds 1 Attack.

cards.name: Ion Neutralizer
cards.effect: When worn on infantry units, it ignores enemy protection perks and adds 2 firepower.

cards.name: Ion Shot
cards.effect: When equipped to an infantry unit, it grants the ion weapon perk and adds 2 firepower.

cards.name: Ion Torpedo
cards.effect: When equipped to an infantry unit, it grants the ion weapon perk and adds 2 firepower.

cards.name: Jump Pack
cards.effect: Increases range by 3 when equipped on infantry units.

cards.name: Medical Droid
cards.effect: All units you are currently owned by adding health 2 until the end of the next battle.

cards.name: Personal Shield
cards.effect: Adds 3 shield when equipped to infantry units.

cards.name: Pulse Cannon
cards.effect: When equipped to an infantry unit, grants first strike perk and +2 attack.

cards.name: Scattergun
cards.effect: When worn on an infantry unit, adds 1 firepower and pushes enemies back 1 block before battle.

cards.name: Scout Pistol
cards.effect: When worn on an infantry unit, it deals 5 damage to the enemy even if it is defeated in battle.

cards.name: Smart Rocket
cards.effect: When equipped to an infantry unit, it grants Heavy Weapon Perk and adds 3 Firepower. The Rebel Alliance only has soldiers, so based on rank 0, the first hit deals 6 damage, ignoring enemy evasion.

cards.name: Smoke Shell
cards.effect: Adds 2 Evasion when equipped by an Infantry Unit.

cards.name: Stinger Pistol
cards.effect: When equipped on an infantry unit, any enemy units that survive an engagement with that unit are incapacitated for 2 turns.

cards.name: Base Shield
cards.effect: Rehabilitate the destroyed shields, or overdose the alive shields. The overcharged shield lasts until the next turn starts.

cards.name: Blaster Cannon
cards.effect: When used, it attacks a random enemy with 1 damage. The number of attacks is equal to the number of other cards used while holding this card. The number of attacks is displayed at the bottom right of the card.https://en.namu.wiki/w/%EC%8A%A4%ED%83%80%EC%9B%8C%EC%A6%88%20%EB%B0%B0%ED%8B%80%ED%94%84%EB%A1%A0%ED%8A%B8/%EB%B2%A0%EC%9D%B4%EC%8A%A4%20%EC%BB%A4%EB%A7%A8%EB%93%9C#fn-1

cards.name: Infantry Turret
cards.effect: Charges base cannon energy to maximum.

cards.name: Antipersonnel Mines
cards.effect: The first unit to reach range 1 after placing on the base takes 6 damage.

cards.name: Scout Binoculars
cards.effect: A new star card is drawn, and units can attack anywhere on the board. As it is perfectly compatible with the new command, it is also a semi-required card.

cards.name: Squad Shield
cards.effect: Rebuilds all base shields and overcharges for one turn.

cards.name: Support Droid
cards.effect: Restores 3 base HP. Essential for some sieges where the base starts with low health.

cards.name: Trap
cards.effect: When an enemy unit attempts to infiltrate the base, it is immediately destroyed.

cards.name: Vehicle Turret
cards.effect: Base Cannon's next attack is doubled.

cards.name: Ultrasonic Bomb
cards.effect: Remove all shields and deal 1 damage.

cards.name: Bombardment
cards.effect: Deal 2 damage to all units in an area.

cards.name: Dioxis Grenade
cards.effect: All enemies within the coordinates are poisoned and lose 2 HP per turn.

cards.name: Disruptor Rifle
cards.effect: All aircraft enemies on the board are halved based on their maximum health.

cards.name: Shock Fuse Grenade
cards.effect: Deal 5 damage to a unit.

cards.name: Inner Perimeter
cards.effect: Deal 2 damage to all enemies at range 1.

cards.name: Ion Blast
cards.effect: All enemies within 1-2 range take 1 damage and lose their perk. Invalid against enemy hero units.

cards.name: Ion Grenade
cards.effect: Removes the shields of all enemies within the coordinates and deals 3 damage.

cards.name: Orbital Strike
cards.effect: Deal 5 damage to all enemies in the area. A semi-required card.

cards.name: Proximity Bomb
cards.effect: Deal 5 damage to a unit.

cards.name: Shock Grenade
cards.effect: All units within the coordinates are incapacitated once and take 2 damage.

cards.name: Thermal Detonator
cards.effect: Deal 4 damage to all enemies within the coordinates.

cards.name: Thermal Imploder
cards.effect: Remove one unit immediately and discard it. If you put it in, the time to write it will come.

cards.name: Elite Training
cards.effect: When equipped on a unit card, it advances by 1 rank. It is very effective for A-wing, where quick promotion is key.

cards.name: New Orders
cards.effect: When equipped on a unit card, it can attack anywhere on the board. A semi-required card.

cards.name: Squad Leader
cards.effect: Grants Squad Leader Perk when equipped on a unit card.

cards.name: War Veteran
cards.effect: Adds 2 ATK when equipped to a unit card.

cards.effect: Unit-like star card: Atk 3 / FP 5 / Eva 2 / HP 6 / Shield 1; First Strike, Squad Leader
